attacks.name: Sensational Uppercut
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

attacks.name: The Defense Rests
steps: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| and |§stun§Stun| special conditions. If the defender already has the Slow special condition, it gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Defenders of Arcadia (Affiliation: A-Force)
superPowers.body: When an allied character is damaged by an enemy effect, another allied character may gain 1 |!power|. A character may not gain more than 1 |!power| from this |!leadership| ability per Turn.

superPowers.name: Clear the Court
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Superior Weight Training
superPowers.body: During the next attack made by this character this Turn, add dice to the attack roll equal to the |!size| of the defender.

superPowers.name: Legal Defense
superPowers.body: When an allied character within |!range| 2 of this character is targeted by an attack, this character may use this superpower. This character becomes the target of the attack regardless of |!range| and LOS.

superPowers.name: Gamma Transfusion
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|. Additionally, after an attack targeting this character is resolved, if this character suffered |!damage|, it may Advance Toward the attacker |!range_small|.

The Defense Rests Strength increased from 9 to 10.
Stamina decreased from 20 to 10 on Healthy side.
